newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Two hurt as light plane crashes near Wellington.
newsitem.headline: Two hurt as light plane crashes near Wellington.

text.p: Two people received minor head injuries when a light aircraft crashed in Pauatahanui inlet near Wellington on Monday, the ambulance service said.
It was the second light plane crash in the Wellington region on Monday.

"It looks like there were two people on board who got out of the aircraft when it ditched in the harbour and waded about 75 metres to shore. They've both got minor head injuries, they're sore and cold, and we're transporting them to hospital now," ambulance control manager Peter Winthrop said.
A fire service spokesman confirmed the plane had come down in Pauatahanui inlet but had no further details.
Earlier, Wellington airport was closed after a Cessna 185 plane crashed on take-off and careered off the runway. No one was injured.
